_comment: M13a activation-popup labelling decision (hand-pinned ground truth, NOT --record; same route as logger_extract.json). OrderDeck.CountActionBlocks classifies a deck token list into NUMBERED action blocks: move/attack/special/rest/interact count, 'shuffle' is an unnumbered note, unknown tokens render verbatim and are never counted. The bridge renders exactly 1 action as the unnumbered solo line (ui.json actionSoloFormat) and >=2 as 'Aktion {n}' (the former tree-lead line doctrineTreeLead was REMOVED in M13c, 30.10; the counting decision pinned here is untouched). Presentation-only: planning behaviour and all Canon vectors are untouched, there is no Python sim twin. 'numbered' = the tree numbering applies; solo = the solo label applies; both false = no action-block label exists (validator rejects such cards upstream).
